criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to card functionality, activation, expiration, or replacement.

categories.name: Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Concerns about transactions made without the customer's consent.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems or questions regarding money transfers, including delays and failures.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Issues related to adding funds to an account or card.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions or problems related to verifying identity or source of funds.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with transactions, cards, or services.

categories.name: Exchange Rates
categories.definition: Questions about currency exchange rates and related fees.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete an account.

categories.name: Refunds and Disputes
categories.definition: Requests for refunds or disputes over transactions.

categories.name: PIN Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to PIN usage, blocking, or resetting.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered when using ATMs, such as card retention or incorrect cash dispensed.

categories.name: Virtual Card Issues
categories.definition: Questions or problems related to virtual or disposable cards.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries about updating personal details or managing account settings.

categories.name: Service Availability
categories.definition: Questions about the availability of services or products in different regions.

categories.name: Payment Declines
categories.definition: Issues related to declined payments or transactions.

categories.name: App and Technical Support
categories.definition: Technical issues or questions related to using the banking app or website.
